concerns.text: Training a ~50 M‑parameter diffusion model on a CPU‑only free‑tier GitHub Actions runner (2 CPU cores, 7 GB RAM) is unlikely to finish within the stated ≤ 6 h wall‑clock limit, even with gradient accumulation and activation checkpointing. The compute budget appears insufficient for full diffusion training, risking a failure to meet FR‑002 and SC‑005.

LPIPS computation on the full test set using the `lpips` library is CPU‑intensive and may exceed the 6 h runtime budget, especially when combined with other metric calculations. Without GPU acceleration, this step is likely infeasible under the free‑tier constraints.
FID calculation via `torchmetrics` (InceptionV3) on CPU is computationally heavy and can dominate runtime and memory usage, potentially breaching the ≤ 7 GB RAM limit and the 6 h wall‑clock budget.
